Subject: Production latency and 5xx spike — us-west-2 — immediate help needed

Team —

We started seeing a sharp degradation in our Redwood-backed generation paths out of us-west-2 around 07:50 PDT. Symptoms:
- 30-40% median latency increase for text.generate calls (p50 from 220ms -> 320ms),
- sustained 5xx rate at ~4.8% for the last 20 minutes,
- throughput dropped ~40% vs baseline; some requests are timing out and causing client retries.

This is impacting our session-based features (tokenization/kv cache sensitive) and users are seeing errors in product. We captured request/response logs and an aggregate telemetry dump (attached).

Can Redwood spin up a cross-region spill (route new traffic to us-east-1) and confirm whether prefix KV cache and session affinity will survive? We need an estimated timeline and a point of contact — this is on-call for our platform.

Attachments: crestline_telemetry.zip (application/zip)

— Amir

2) Asking infra to provision a temporary capacity pool in us-west-2 for stuck connections while routing drains.
3) Rishi, can you validate whether the current quantization profile change from last night could be causing kernel OOMs on the us-west-2 GPU pool? If so, rollback plan and hotfix please.

Marissa — I’ve attached a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.docx) for approvals/comments; we’ll need an exec-level note if there’s customer impact beyond 30 minutes.

Update and technical root cause:
- Root cause: a quantization profile push last night created a code path that increased kernel memory usage for certain sequence-length distributions. On a subset of us-west-2 hosts this surfaced as intermittent OOMs and degraded batching efficiency, manifesting as elevated latency + 5xxs and throughput collapse for sessions with long-prefix KV usage.

Mitigation completed (15:20 PDT):
1) Rolled back the quantization profile at 14:12; observed immediate drop in OOM counts.
2) Opened a temporary capacity pool to absorb backlog while route drainer completed (pool at +20% extra capacity).
3) Activated cross-region spill to us-east-1 for new sessions — traffic shift reached ~62% in 18 minutes; we've kept sticky sessions on origin where possible to preserve KV affinity.

Next steps:
- Runbook update: added a rollback checklist and a pre-deploy regression test for quantization profiles. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-8012
- Postmortem: will open SUP-8035 for a full RCA and impact analysis; tentative owner: rishi_malhotra.
- Customer comms: David / Marissa — recommend a T+4h follow-up note summarizing actions and any credits.

Attachments: crestline_telemetry.zip (sanitized subset) — retained in incident folder.

— Rishi
